_about: USD prices per model for cost_usd on llm_requests (app/ai/pricing.py, docs/llm-gateway.md). Keys: 'provider/model' or 'provider/*'. Fields: input_per_million, output_per_million, cached_input_per_million (default = input), per_image. Free-tier calls are still priced at the paid rate, so cost_usd is what the same traffic would cost on a paid plan. Models without an entry record no cost. Override single entries with LLM_PRICES.
_sources: Groq and Gemini figures were read from the providers' pricing pages on 2026-10-19 (Standard tier). gemini-3.8-flash doubles to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01. Kie AI bills credits per image: add 'kie/<model>': {"per_image": <USD>} from your Kie account to price images.
